intro: Each suggestion is a decision for you. Nothing here has been implemented. Pick one option per item and reply with the IDs, for example 'S-01: A, S-02: A'. The 'Recommended' option is a suggestion for your review only.

suggestions.title: Confirm the intended ASIN for each product
suggestions.why: The submitted codes are not 10-character ASINs, and each resolves to a different listing (F-01, F-03). Without intent, no intent field can be filled.

options.label: You confirm the intended ASIN from your own Associates or seller records
options.tradeoff: Slowest, but the only option that records true intent.

options.label: Treat the observed redirect ASIN as intended
options.tradeoff: Fast, but assumes intent that has not been confirmed. Not recommended.

options.label: Replace the five links with new links you choose
options.tradeoff: Clean record. Requires new links.

suggestions.title: Run the one-link-per-product test in Associates Central
suggestions.why: No observed redirect carries the tag (F-02). The test is the only way to confirm destination and tracking before scaling (F-22).

options.label: You run five click-through tests and report each result
options.tradeoff: Gives a checked answer per product. Use a click-through check only, because §6(u) bars purchases through your own links.

options.label: Sequence after S-01
options.tradeoff: Avoids testing the wrong listing.

options.label: Skip. Keep the supplied links as interim links
options.tradeoff: Not recommended. The compliance status stays unresolved.

suggestions.effort: Low (five clicks and a report check)

suggestions.title: Choose where the analytics endpoint runs
suggestions.why: GitHub Pages cannot run the collector, so the five events record nothing yet (F-11). The collector is written and tested.

options.label: Host analytics/collector.py on a server you control
options.tradeoff: Full control. Needs a small server and a domain. Stores no IP addresses or cookies.

options.label: Use a hosted analytics vendor
options.tradeoff: Less setup. Vendor privacy terms were not evaluated in this session.

options.label: No site analytics. Rely on Associates reports only
options.tradeoff: Least data. Click-level insight is limited.

suggestions.title: Confirm the site's brand name
suggestions.why: The working name 'The Countertop Guide' was not supplied by you and has no trademark check (F-15).

source.label: Participation Requirements §1(g): no Amazon marks in domain or tag

options.label: Keep 'The Countertop Guide' after a trademark search
options.tradeoff: No change needed. The search is a check you run.

options.label: Use a name you choose
options.tradeoff: Your brand. Needs the same check.

options.label: Keep the repository name 'WinA'
options.tradeoff: Plain, but reads as internal.

suggestions.title: Set the publishing cadence
suggestions.why: The site proposes two guides a month. Nothing confirms that rate.

source.label: Participation Requirements §2(b): remove promotion mentions when they end

options.label: Two guides a month
options.tradeoff: Steady. Gives time to re-observe listings each cycle.

options.label: One guide a week
options.tradeoff: Faster. Higher upkeep and re-verification load.

options.label: One guide a month
options.tradeoff: Lowest upkeep.

suggestions.title: Choose the byline approach
suggestions.why: No author was supplied. Bylines read 'Editorial team' (F-14).

options.label: Keep 'Editorial team'
options.tradeoff: Accurate. Less personal.

options.label: A named author you supply, with their real credentials
options.tradeoff: More personal. Requires your author details.

options.label: Topic-based bylines
options.tradeoff: Middle ground. Still needs names.

suggestions.title: Decide on imagery
suggestions.why: No product photos are used because reuse rights were not verified (F-16). Manufacturer claims also remain unverified (F-19).

options.label: Keep typographic covers
options.tradeoff: No rights risk. Less visual.

options.label: Commission original illustrations you own
options.tradeoff: Distinctive. Cost and time.

options.label: Use Amazon-served images within the Associates terms
options.tradeoff: Needs a rights review first.

suggestions.title: Fill the commission rates from Associates Central
suggestions.why: The rate schedule requires sign-in and was not readable (F-06). Commission potential cannot be estimated without it.

options.label: You copy the Home & Kitchen rate and date into data/products.json
options.tradeoff: Verified and dated. Takes one lookup.

options.label: Leave blank
options.tradeoff: No commission estimate.

suggestions.title: Decide on price and rating display
suggestions.why: Price and star ratings are withheld under Participation Requirements §2(b) and §6(t) (F-05, F-21).

options.label: Apply for PA-API or Creators API access, if eligible, and display data as the License allows
options.tradeoff: Enables price and rating display. Eligibility was not verified.

options.label: Keep withheld
options.tradeoff: Compliant by default. Less buyer information.

options.label: Show 'check price on Amazon' with no figures
options.tradeoff: Simple. Still sends readers to the listing.

suggestions.recommended: B until eligibility is confirmed, then A

suggestions.title: Choose the site domain
suggestions.why: The site runs at the GitHub Pages address. A custom domain would need registration (F-17 touches the application URL).

options.label: Keep the GitHub Pages address
options.tradeoff: Free. Must match the Associates application.

options.label: Register a custom domain
options.tradeoff: Brand-friendly. Needs a registrar account and an Associates URL update.

options.label: Defer
options.tradeoff: No change now.

suggestions.title: Connect Google Search Console
suggestions.why: Verification needs your Google account (F-13). Without it, the sitemap is not submitted and no search data is available.

source.label: Google: build and submit a sitemap

options.label: You verify the site and submit sitemap.xml
options.tradeoff: Gives real query data. Recommended.

options.label: Defer
options.tradeoff: No search data.

suggestions.title: Choose how guide topics are picked
suggestions.why: The four topics are editorial hypotheses, not measured demand (Q-08).

options.label: Keep the four topics as the working list
options.tradeoff: Already written. Not yet tested.

options.label: Replace with topics chosen from measured queries after 60 days of data
options.tradeoff: Evidence-led. Slower start.

options.label: Add seasonal topics on a calendar
options.tradeoff: Timely. Needs a calendar.

suggestions.title: Confirm the deployment method
suggestions.why: The site is published from /docs on main, which GitHub Docs supports (SRC-08).

options.label: Publish from /docs on main
options.tradeoff: Simple. The build output is committed.

options.label: Publish with a GitHub Actions workflow
options.tradeoff: Build on deploy. Needs the workflow permission.

suggestions.title: Confirm disclosure placement
suggestions.why: The statement is under the masthead and in the footer. A reviewer must confirm placement against FTC guidance (F-07).

options.label: Keep the strip under the masthead and in the footer (current)
options.tradeoff: Meets the on-every-page request.

options.label: Add a short disclosure beside each sponsored link
options.tradeoff: Closest to the product. More repetition.

options.label: Both A and B
options.tradeoff: Most visible. Recommended for review.

suggestions.title: Choose a repository license
suggestions.why: The repository has no LICENSE file (F-20).

options.label: Add an open-source license you choose
options.tradeoff: Clear reuse terms.

options.label: No license (all rights reserved by default)
options.tradeoff: Current state.
